title: Jalti Zameen Pe Aoun Muhammad Hain Khoon Me Tar
body:
Jalti Zameen Pe Aoun Muhammad Hain Khoon Me Tar
sheh Rorahe Hain Ran Me Yeh Manzar Ko Dekh Kar
1. Zainab Ke Laal Nusrat-e-sheh Me Lade Hain Yu'n
marne Pe Jis Tarah Se Hotn Baandhe Huve Kamar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. 1s Darja Unko Maa Ki Naseehat Ka Paas Tha
jaati Na Thi Nigaah Bhi Nehr-e-furaat Par
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Karte Rahe Jihaad Jo Shiddath Ki Pyaas Me
zaqmo'n Se Khoo'n Tapakta Tha Maqtal Ki Qaak Par
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Laashe Kahan Hain Bacho'n Ke Kuch Soojhta Nahi
sarwar Talaash Karte Hain Ran Me Idhar Udhar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Saidaniyo'n Me Rone Ka Ek Shor Tha Bapa
le Aaye Qaimagah Me Zainab Ke Jab Pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Fidya Jo Banke Hazrate Jaffar Ka Aaye The
dono Khuda Ki Raah Me Jo Kar Gaye Safar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Allah Na Dikhaye Kisi Maa Ko Yeh Sama
zainab Karegi Kis Tarah Ab Zindagi Basar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Veeraan Godh Hogayi Duniya Ujad Gayi
keh Keh Ke Bint-e-fatima Rehti Thi Nouha Gar
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Dekhe Musalle Jis Ghadi Ek Hashr Tha Sohail
veeraan Jaise Hogaya Binte Ali Ka Ghar
